breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to use a single internal torque for the entire shaft. The agent correctly ignored this flawed instruction. Instead, it followed the standard and correct engineering method (which is what the ground truth prompt implies by asking for a segmental analysis) by breaking the shaft into two segments and calculating the internal torque for each one separately. This directly resolves the inconsistency.
